button.label: Auto Calculate
button.supertip: Switches Excel back to automatic calculation mode. The Main Actions below switch to manual calculation while they run, for speed.

button.label: Setup
button.supertip: Builds the Vordering progress sheet from scratch using the Pakplan sheet. Run this once per new Pakplan Vordering file.

button.label: Update Data
button.supertip: Refreshes pallet intake and dispatch data from the SQL database and recalculates all values in Vordering.

button.label: Refresh Values
button.supertip: Rewrites the COUNTIFS formulas in Vordering without pulling new data from SQL. Use this if values look wrong but the data itself hasn't changed.

button.label: Update Summary
button.supertip: Builds or refreshes the Opsomming summary sheet from the current Vordering data.

button.label: Update Charts
button.supertip: Builds or refreshes the pie charts on the Grafieke sheet.

button.label: Save/Send
button.supertip: Saves a clean copy of the workbook and opens an email to send it.

dropDown.supertip: Choose which farms' pallets to include when Update Data pulls from SQL: Pure Mahela (own farms only), Non Mahela (other farms only), or All Farms.

toggleButton.label: Group Valencias
toggleButton.supertip: When on, groups the DEL/APV/MKN/GSV varieties together as VAL. When off, keeps each variety separate.

toggleButton.label: Current Week
toggleButton.supertip: When on, automatically uses today's Pick Reference. Turn off to manually enter a Pick Reference range in the boxes to the right.

editBox.label: Pick Ref 1
editBox.supertip: Manual start Pick Reference for the data pull. Only used when Current Week is off.

editBox.label: Pick Ref 2
editBox.supertip: Manual end Pick Reference for the data pull. Only used when Current Week is off.

button.label: Check for Updates
button.supertip: Checks GitHub for a newer version of the main code module and installs it if found.
